description: This file defines functions related to gateway installation authentication policies, including checking for explicit auth modes, configured passwords, environment-based credentials, and determining whether a token is required for installation.

methods.name: function hasExplicitGatewayInstallAuthMode( hasExplicitGatewayInstallAuthMode
methods.description: Checks if the gateway installation auth mode is explicitly set to 'token', 'password', 'none', or 'trusted-proxy'.

methods.name: function hasConfiguredGatewayPasswordForInstall(cfg: OpenClawConfig): boolean { hasConfiguredGatewayPasswordForInstall
methods.description: Determines if a configured password exists for gateway install based on the configuration.

methods.name: function hasDurableGatewayPasswordEnvForInstall( hasDurableGatewayPasswordEnvForInstall
methods.description: Checks if durable environment variables for gateway password are set, which survive outside the shell.

methods.name: export function shouldRequireGatewayTokenForInstall( shouldRequireGatewayTokenForInstall
methods.description: Main exported function that decides if a gateway token is required for installation based on config and environment.

ctags.name: durableServiceEnv
ctags.pattern: /^  const durableServiceEnv = collectDurableServiceEnvVars({ env, config: cfg });$/
